title: Christmas Cocktail Clipart Bundle
author: HBM Clipart
description:
Celebrate the season with this Christmas Cocktail Clipart Bundle — a whimsical set of festive watercolor drink illustrations perfect for holiday designs. Each clipart features cozy cocktails, Christmas mugs, and sparkling beverages decorated with candy canes, holly, whipped cream, cranberries, and ornaments. Ideal for invitations, menus, mugs, shirts, stickers, sublimation, and digital crafts. Includes high-resolution PNG files with transparent backgrounds for easy layering. Bring holiday cheer and bar-inspired magic to your creative projects this Christmas!
Our Watercolor Clipart Bundle is a collection of high-resolution Watercolor graphics. 
HOW DOES IT WORK?
——————————-
1. Once purchased, you will receive a downloadable link to a zip files.
2. After downloading zip files, extract them.
3. Use the in your projects, create digital artwork or use them for your POD business.
DETAILS
* 40 Individual TRANSPARENT PNG files
* 4000x 4000 pixels
* Each PNG is high resolution quality 300 DPI.
LICENCE:
* Each element comes with the freedom to use it for both personal and commercial projects.
Limitations:
* Please do not redistribute or resell as clipart.
Thank you for your purchase! We appreciate your support and hope you enjoy creating a variety of products with the new clipart.
IMPORTANT NOTE
1. This is a digital product. You will not receive any physical elements with this purchase.
2. There are no returns when purchasing a digital download. Please contact me with any questions before purchasing.
3. Colors may vary based on monitor, printer, and card stock.
